verification_report.summary: The proof correctly establishes necessity by injecting each subset of X into its matched neighbors and establishes sufficiency by induction on |X|. In Case 1, both induced subgraphs satisfy the neighborhood inequality and their matchings combine disjointly; in Case 2, deleting an adjacent pair preserves the inequality for the smaller graph. The statement is self-contained, all assumptions are used appropriately, and there are no external references or hard-prohibition violations.
